name: starbucks_get_drink_calories
intent: Check how many calories are in a Starbucks drink
description: Opens a Starbucks menu item, uses its preselected Grande size, and reads the calorie count shown on the product page.
patterns: how many calories are in a drink
what is the calorie count for a menu item
check the calories in a drink

inputs.name: drink_name
inputs.description: The Starbucks menu drink to look up.

inputs.name: size_name
inputs.description: The drink size whose calories are requested; Grande is preselected on the product page in this run.

steps.intent: Tap Order to open the ordering section
Go back to dismiss the location permission prompt
Tap Skip to bypass café selection
Tap Search Menu to look for {{drink_name}}
Select {{drink_name}} from the available search suggestions
Open {{drink_name}} from the results to view the calories for the {{size_name}} size
